statement: The community USB HID notes describe 0x80/0x81 USB controller commands: status 0x01, initial handshake 0x02, baudrate 0x03, second handshake 0x02 and no-timeout/force-USB 0x04. Handshake 0x02 may be sent once before 0x03, followed by a second after baud switch; OpenPuck emulates matching 0x80/0x81 command classes.
